summary: CWE-585 (empty synchronized block): in helperBad() the synchronized block was empty and the shared counter update `intBad = intBad * 2;` ran outside it, so the two threads mutated intBad without mutual exclusion (lost-update race). Moved the update inside the synchronized block so the read-modify-write is atomic under the class lock, matching the safe pattern in helperGood1(). The feature (doubling the shared counter from two threads and writing the result) is preserved.
